question:
Six people A, B, C, D, E and F live on six different floors of the same building. The bottom-most floor of the building is numbered as 1; the floor above it is numbered as 2 and so on. The topmost floor is numbered as 6.

A lives on an even-numbered floor. Only three people live between A and B. F lives immediately above E. B does not live on floor number 2. Only two people live between F and D. F lives on an even-numbered floor. Who lives on floor number 3?
solution:

Six people A, B, C, D, E, and F live on six different floors of the same building.

The bottom-most floor of the building is numbered as 1; the floor above it is numbered as 2 and so on. The topmost floor is numbered as 6.

1) A lives on an even-numbered floor. Only three people live between A and B.

2) B does not live on floor number 2.
